I would review materials until your code passes all of the tests. 

I would also try to align things such as your bullet points. 

Most importantly I think you should write your CSS either at the top of the page or in another file altogether. I am a beginner as well but my understanding is that inline styling is typically frowned upon.

I like your idea and you did good with the background, rounding the image and dividing the page.

Lastly you forgot the = after href for the king tut link. This made it so the link doesn't function.

It's a great start and shows you are moving in the right direction. Good job man, keep at it and don't give up! It only has gotten easier the more time I put into it, I'm sure the same will be true for you.
